summary.ru: Предлоги движения показывают, куда и как перемещается объект: цель (to), внутрь (into), на поверхность (onto), наружу (out of), с поверхности (off), сквозь (through), поперёк (across), вдоль (along), над (over), под (under), по направлению (towards), мимо (past) и вокруг (around/round).
summary.en: Prepositions of movement show where and how something moves: destination (to), inside (into), onto a surface (onto), out (out of), off a surface (off), through, across, along, over, under, towards, past and around/round.

heading.ru: To, into, onto, out of, off — цель и направление
heading.en: To, into, onto, out of, off

body.ru: **To** называет конечную точку движения. **Into** означает движение внутрь пространства, **onto** — на поверхность. **Out of** — движение изнутри наружу, **off** — с поверхности или с транспорта.
body.en: **To** names the end point **of** movement. **Into** means moving **inside** a space, **onto** means moving **onto** a surface. **Out of** means movement **from** **inside** **to** **outside**, and **off** means away **from** a surface or a vehicle.

heading.ru: Through, across, along — сквозь, поперёк, вдоль

body.ru: **Through** — движение сквозь замкнутое пространство или внутри него. **Across** — с одной стороны на другую. **Along** — вдоль линии или поверхности.
body.en: **Through** is movement **inside** an enclosed space or **from** one end **of** it **to** the other. **Across** is movement **from** one side **to** the other. **Along** is movement following a line or a surface.

heading.ru: Over, under, towards, past — над, под, к, мимо

body.ru: **Over** — над препятствием или через его верх, **under** — под чем-то. **Towards** показывает направление, но не обязательно достижение цели. Past — мимо чего-то с продолжением движения.
body.en: **Over** is **above** an obstacle or **across** its top, and **under** is **below** something. **Towards** shows a direction **without** necessarily reaching the goal. Past means moving **by** something and continuing.

body.ru: **Around**, а в британском английском и round, описывает круговое движение или движение вокруг чего-то. **From** … **to** называет начало и конец маршрута; в речи встречаются и другие пары предлогов.
body.en: **Around** — and **in** British English also round — describes circular movement or movement surrounding something. **From** … **to** names the start and end **of** a route; other pairs **of** prepositions also occur **in** speech.

questions.sentence: My father leaves the house at six and drives ___ work.

translation.ru: Папа выходит из дома в шесть и едет на работу.

explanation.ru: To указывает конечную точку движения: drive to work — ехать на работу. From означало бы движение с работы, что противоречит первой части предложения.
explanation.en: To marks the destination: drive to work. From would mean the opposite direction, which contradicts the first part of the sentence.

questions.sentence: The thief opened the window and climbed ___ the house to steal the jewels.

translation.ru: Вор открыл окно и залез в дом, чтобы украсть драгоценности.

explanation.ru: Into показывает движение внутрь: climbed into the house — залез в дом. Слова to steal the jewels подтверждают, что вор проник внутрь, а out of означало бы, что он выбирается наружу.
explanation.en: Into shows movement inside: climbed into the house. The purpose to steal the jewels confirms that he got inside, while out of would mean he was getting out.

questions.sentence: The rain was so heavy that we ran ___ the nearest shop to stay dry.

translation.ru: Дождь был такой сильный, что мы забежали в ближайший магазин, чтобы не промокнуть.

explanation.ru: Into показывает вход внутрь помещения: ran into the shop — забежали в магазин. Under и across не передают идею входа.
explanation.en: Into shows going inside a place: ran into the shop. Under and across do not express entering.

questions.sentence: The cat jumped ___ the table and knocked over a glass.

translation.ru: Кошка запрыгнула на стол и опрокинула стакан.

explanation.ru: Onto — движение на поверхность: jump onto the table. Into — внутрь, through — сквозь, out of — наружу.
explanation.en: Onto shows movement onto a surface: jump onto the table. Into means inside, through means through, and out of means out.

questions.sentence: When the train stopped, we stepped ___ the platform and looked for the exit.

translation.ru: Когда поезд остановился, мы вышли на платформу и стали искать выход.

explanation.ru: Step onto — шагнуть на поверхность: onto the platform. Into означало бы внутрь, over — через верх, under — под.
explanation.en: Step onto means to move onto a surface: onto the platform. Into would mean inside, over means above, and under means below.

questions.sentence: The children ran ___ the house to catch the school bus.

translation.ru: Дети выбежали из дома, чтобы успеть на школьный автобус.

explanation.ru: Out of — изнутри наружу: run out of the house. Into означало бы движение внутрь, а onto и off здесь не подходят.
explanation.en: Out of shows movement from inside to outside: run out of the house. Into would mean the opposite direction, and onto and off do not fit.

questions.sentence: We got ___ the car and walked towards the beach.

translation.ru: Мы вышли из машины и пошли к пляжу.

explanation.ru: Get out of the car — выйти из машины. Дальше сказано walked towards the beach, значит, речь о выходе, а не о входе.
explanation.en: Get out of the car means to leave it; the next clause about walking to the beach shows it is exiting, not entering.

questions.sentence: We drove ___ the tunnel and came out on the other side of the mountain.

translation.ru: Мы проехали через туннель и выехали с другой стороны горы.

explanation.ru: Through — сквозь замкнутое пространство: drive through a tunnel. Across — по поверхности поперёк, over — над, along — вдоль.
explanation.en: Through is used for movement inside an enclosed space: drive through a tunnel. Across is for surfaces, over means above, and along means following a line.

questions.sentence: Look both ways before you walk ___ the busy road to the other side.

translation.ru: Посмотри в обе стороны, прежде чем переходить оживлённую дорогу на другую сторону.

explanation.ru: Across — с одной стороны на другую: walk across the road. Оборот to the other side прямо указывает на переход через дорогу, поэтому along и under здесь не подходят.
explanation.en: Across means from one side to the other: walk across the road. The phrase to the other side makes the crossing explicit, so along and under do not fit.

questions.sentence: We walked ___ the river until we reached the old bridge.

translation.ru: Мы шли вдоль реки, пока не дошли до старого моста.

explanation.ru: Along — вдоль линии: walk along the river. Across — поперёк, through — сквозь, over — над.
explanation.en: Along means following a line: walk along the river. Across means from side to side, through means inside something, and over means above.

questions.sentence: The dog jumped ___ the fence and ran into the garden.

translation.ru: Собака перепрыгнула через забор и убежала в сад.

explanation.ru: Over — через верх препятствия: jump over the fence. Under, through и into не подходят к забору в этом значении.
explanation.en: Over means above an obstacle: jump over the fence. Under, through and into do not fit the meaning here.

questions.sentence: The cat hid ___ the table so that nobody could see it.

translation.ru: Кошка спряталась под столом, чтобы её никто не видел.

explanation.ru: Under — под предметом: hide under the table. On означало бы «на столе», где кошку было бы видно, а over и into здесь не подходят.
explanation.en: Under means below something: hide under the table. On would mean on the table, where the cat would be visible, and over and into do not fit.

questions.sentence: The dog ran ___ the postman, wagging its tail happily.

translation.ru: Собака побежала к почтальону, радостно виляя хвостом.

explanation.ru: Towards — по направлению к: run towards the postman. From означало бы «от», что противоречит радостному вилянию хвостом.
explanation.en: Towards means in the direction of: run towards the postman. From would mean away, which contradicts the happy tail.

questions.sentence: The shop is open ___ Monday to Friday, but it closes at noon on Saturday.

translation.ru: Магазин работает с понедельника по пятницу, но в субботу закрывается в полдень.

explanation.ru: From … to — от … до: from Monday to Friday. At и since не подходят к парной конструкции с to.
explanation.en: From … to is the pattern for a range: from Monday to Friday. At and since do not fit this paired construction with to.

questions.sentence: The little boy fell ___ his bike and hurt his knee.

translation.ru: Маленький мальчик упал с велосипеда и ушиб колено.

explanation.ru: Off — с поверхности: fall off a bike. Onto, under и along не сочетаются с fall в значении «упасть с».
explanation.en: Off means away from a surface: fall off a bike. Onto, under and along do not combine with fall in this meaning.

questions.sentence: We drove ___ the beach and spent the afternoon swimming.

translation.ru: Мы поехали на пляж и провели вторую половину дня, купаясь.

explanation.ru: To указывает пункт назначения: drove to the beach — поехали на пляж. At, under и from здесь не подходят.
explanation.en: To marks the destination: drove to the beach. At, under and from do not fit here.

questions.sentence: The nurse walked ___ the room and sat down by the bed.

translation.ru: Медсестра вошла в палату и села у кровати.

explanation.ru: Into — движение внутрь помещения: walked into the room and sat down by the bed. Out of означало бы выход из комнаты, а onto и along здесь не подходят.
explanation.en: Into shows movement inside a room: walked into the room and sat down by the bed. Out of would mean leaving the room, and onto and along do not fit.

questions.sentence: The dog jumped ___ the sofa and fell asleep.

translation.ru: Собака запрыгнула на диван и уснула.

explanation.ru: Onto — движение на поверхность: jumped onto the sofa. Into, out of и through не подходят к дивану в этом значении.
explanation.en: Onto shows movement onto a surface: jumped onto the sofa. Into, out of and through do not fit here.

questions.sentence: The teacher walked ___ the classroom and the lesson ended.

translation.ru: Учитель вышел из класса, и урок закончился.

explanation.ru: Out of — движение изнутри наружу: walked out of the classroom. Into означало бы вход, а onto и over здесь не подходят.
explanation.en: Out of shows movement from inside to outside: walked out of the classroom. Into would mean entering, and onto and over do not fit.

questions.sentence: The river runs ___ the city centre, dividing it into two halves.

translation.ru: Река протекает через центр города, разделяя его на две половины.

explanation.ru: Through — сквозь территорию: runs through the city centre. Река делит центр на две части, поэтому towards («по направлению к») не подходит.
explanation.en: Through means across an area: runs through the city centre. The river divides the centre into two halves, so towards (in the direction of) does not fit.

questions.sentence: The team rowed ___ the lake to reach the island.

translation.ru: Команда переплыла озеро на лодке, чтобы добраться до острова.

explanation.ru: Across — с одного берега на другой: rowed across the lake. Along, through и over не передают пересечение озера.
explanation.en: Across means from one side to the other: rowed across the lake. Along, through and over do not express crossing the lake.

questions.sentence: We cycled ___ the riverbank for an hour before we found a cafe.

translation.ru: Мы ехали на велосипедах вдоль берега реки час, пока не нашли кафе.

explanation.ru: Along — вдоль линии: cycled along the riverbank. Across, through и over не передают движение параллельно берегу.
explanation.en: Along means following a line: cycled along the riverbank. Across, through and over do not express movement parallel to the bank.

questions.sentence: The cat climbed ___ the garden wall and jumped down.

translation.ru: Кошка перелезла через садовую стену и спрыгнула вниз.

explanation.ru: Over — через верх препятствия: climbed over the wall. Under, through и into здесь не подходят.
explanation.en: Over means above an obstacle: climbed over the wall. Under, through and into do not fit here.

questions.sentence: The fish swam ___ our boat and we could see them clearly.

translation.ru: Рыбы проплыли под нашей лодкой, и мы хорошо их видели.

explanation.ru: Under — ниже чего-то: swam under our boat. Over, across и along не передают положение ниже лодки.
explanation.en: Under means below something: swam under our boat. Over, across and along do not express position below the boat.

questions.sentence: The little girl ran ___ her father when she saw him at the airport.

translation.ru: Маленькая девочка побежала к отцу, когда увидела его в аэропорту.

explanation.ru: Towards — по направлению к: ran towards her father. From означало бы «от», over и under здесь не подходят.
explanation.en: Towards means in the direction of: ran towards her father. From would mean away, and over and under do not fit.

pairs.right: We walked to the park after lunch.
The cat jumped into the box.
The children climbed onto the wall.
The child pulled a toy out of the box.

explanation.ru: To указывает на цель движения, into — внутрь, onto — на поверхность, out of — наружу.
explanation.en: To marks the destination, into means inside, onto means onto a surface, and out of means exiting.

prompt.en: Match each path preposition with its example.

pairs.right: The train went through the tunnel.

left.ru: across — с одной стороны на другую
left.en: across — from one side to the other

pairs.right: The team swam across the lake.
We cycled along the canal.
The horse jumped over the low gate.

explanation.ru: Through — сквозь пространство, across — поперёк, along — вдоль, over — над препятствием.
explanation.en: Through is inside a space, across goes from side to side, along follows a line, and over is above an obstacle.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with its example.

pairs.right: The cat ran under the fence.
She ran towards the bus but missed it.
We cycled from the village to the lake.
She took the picture off the wall.

explanation.ru: Under — под, towards — по направлению, from … to — от … до, off — с поверхности.
explanation.en: Under means below, towards means in the direction of, from … to marks two points, and off means away from a surface.

prompt.en: Match each meaning of the preposition with its example.

left.en: to — the end of a route

pairs.right: After three hours we finally got to the village.
The boy dived into the river without checking the depth.
The monkey jumped onto the branch and hung there.

left.ru: out of — выход из закрытого пространства
left.en: out of — leaving an enclosed space

pairs.right: The students rushed out of the classroom when the bell rang.

explanation.ru: To — конечная точка, into — внутрь, onto — на поверхность, out of — наружу.
explanation.en: To is the end point, into means inside, onto means onto a surface, and out of means leaving an enclosed space.

prompt.en: Match each meaning of the preposition with its example.

pairs.right: We finally got to the campsite before dark.
The hikers walked towards the lake but turned back.
She went into the bank to change some money.
The workers came out of the factory at six.

explanation.ru: To показывает прибытие в пункт, towards — движение в направлении, into — вход внутрь, out of — выход наружу.
explanation.en: To shows arrival at a place, towards shows movement in a direction, into shows entering, and out of shows leaving.

questions.sentence: After the party we walked ___ the station to catch the last train.

translation.ru: После вечеринки мы пошли на вокзал, чтобы успеть на последний поезд.

explanation.ru: To указывает конечную точку движения: walked to the station — пошли на вокзал.
explanation.en: To marks the destination: walked to the station.

questions.sentence: The waiter placed the plate ___ the table.

translation.ru: Официант поставил тарелку на стол.

explanation.ru: Onto — движение на поверхность: placed the plate onto the table.
explanation.en: Onto shows movement onto a surface: placed the plate onto the table.

questions.sentence: The child climbed ___ the chair to reach the shelf.

translation.ru: Ребёнок забрался на стул, чтобы дотянуться до полки.

explanation.ru: Конечная точка — поверхность стула, поэтому ставим onto: climbed onto the chair.
explanation.en: The end point is the surface of the chair, so we use onto: climbed onto the chair.

questions.sentence: He took his wallet ___ his pocket.

translation.ru: Он достал кошелёк из кармана.

explanation.ru: Out of — движение изнутри наружу: took his wallet out of his pocket.
explanation.en: Out of shows movement from inside to outside: took his wallet out of his pocket.

questions.sentence: The ferry moved slowly ___ the harbour and out to sea.

translation.ru: Паром медленно вышел из гавани в открытое море.

explanation.ru: Out of the harbour — «из гавани»: out of показывает движение изнутри наружу.
explanation.en: Out of the harbour shows movement from inside to outside.

questions.sentence: The cat jumped ___ the box and landed on the floor.

translation.ru: Кошка выпрыгнула из коробки и приземлилась на пол.

explanation.ru: Кошка была в коробке и оказалась на полу, значит, движение изнутри наружу — out of.
explanation.en: The cat was in the box and ended up on the floor, so the movement was from inside to outside — out of.

questions.sentence: He fell ___ the ladder and broke his arm.

translation.ru: Он упал с лестницы и сломал руку.

explanation.ru: Off — с поверхности: fell off the ladder — упал с лестницы.
explanation.en: Off means away from a surface: fell off the ladder.

questions.sentence: The sunlight came ___ the window and woke me up.

translation.ru: Солнечный свет проник через окно и разбудил меня.

explanation.ru: Through — сквозь пространство: came through the window — проник через окно.
explanation.en: Through means inside a space: came through the window.

questions.sentence: He swam ___ the river to the other bank.

translation.ru: Он переплыл реку до другого берега.

explanation.ru: Across — с одного берега на другой: swam across the river. Оборот to the other bank подтверждает переход.
explanation.en: Across means from one side to the other: swam across the river. The phrase to the other bank confirms the crossing.

questions.sentence: We drove ___ the coast road for an hour.

translation.ru: Мы час ехали вдоль прибрежной дороги.

explanation.ru: Along — вдоль линии: drove along the coast road.
explanation.en: Along means following a line: drove along the coast road.

questions.sentence: The balloon rose and floated ___ the houses.

translation.ru: Воздушный шар поднялся и поплыл над домами.

explanation.ru: Over — над чем-то: floated over the houses. Under означало бы «под», through — «сквозь».
explanation.en: Over means above something: floated over the houses. Under would mean below, and through would mean inside.

questions.sentence: The ball rolled ___ the sofa, and we could see it underneath.

translation.ru: Мяч закатился под диван, и мы видели его снизу.

explanation.ru: Underneath подтверждает, что мяч оказался ниже дивана: rolled under the sofa.
explanation.en: Underneath confirms that the ball went below the sofa: rolled under the sofa.

questions.sentence: The dog ran ___ the fence and escaped into the field.

translation.ru: Собака проскочила под забором и убежала в поле.

explanation.ru: Under the fence — «под забором»: собака пробралась внизу, поэтому under.
explanation.en: Under the fence means below it: the dog got through underneath, so we use under.

questions.sentence: The children ran ___ the ice-cream van as soon as they saw it.

translation.ru: Дети побежали к фургону с мороженым, как только его увидели.

explanation.ru: Towards — по направлению к: ran towards the ice-cream van. From означало бы «от».
explanation.en: Towards means in the direction of: ran towards the ice-cream van. From would mean away.

questions.sentence: The bus drove ___ our house without stopping.

translation.ru: Автобус проехал мимо нашего дома, не остановившись.

explanation.ru: Past — мимо чего-то: drove past our house. Through означало бы «сквозь дом».
explanation.en: Past means moving by something: drove past our house. Through would mean inside the house.

questions.sentence: We walked ___ the post office and turned left.

translation.ru: Мы прошли мимо почты и повернули налево.

explanation.ru: Past — мимо: walked past the post office и пошли дальше.
explanation.en: Past means moving by something and continuing: walked past the post office.

questions.sentence: The children sat ___ the fire and told stories.

translation.ru: Дети сидели вокруг костра и рассказывали истории.

explanation.ru: Around — вокруг чего-то: sat around the fire.
explanation.en: Around means surrounding something: sat around the fire.

questions.sentence: She turned ___ and walked away without a word.

translation.ru: Она развернулась и молча ушла.

explanation.ru: Turn round — британское сочетание «развернуться»: turn round и уйти.
explanation.en: Turn round is the British phrase for turning to face the other way.

questions.sentence: She dived ___ the swimming pool.

translation.ru: Она нырнула в бассейн.

explanation.ru: Into — движение внутрь: dived into the pool.
explanation.en: Into shows movement inside: dived into the pool.

questions.sentence: The road runs ___ the village to the coast.

translation.ru: Дорога идёт от деревни к побережью.

explanation.ru: From … to — от … до; в паре с to начальная точка вводится предлогом from.
explanation.en: From … to marks a route; with to the starting point is introduced by from.
